rooms.205501: Green vines and thick undergrowth choke the valley floor, and your boots sink into leaf mold that has not been trampled in an age. To the west the land rises toward a scorched iron gate and the way out of the valley. Eastward the greenery thins and gives way to a strange uprising of grey stone. The air is close and humid, and it smells of moss and old rain.
rooms.205502: You stand before Ancalador, a dragon of petrified stone whose limbs are half buried where the earth has filled the crevices between them. Huge oaks have taken root along its flanks and are dwarfed by it all the same. A vague evil seems to rise from the once-living rock that terrorized nations long ago. The wild valley lies back to the west, and to the east a vast stone head gapes open.

205503.description: Rows of stone teeth as tall as trolls line the walls of this vast mouth, and stone molars as broad as iron shields crouch behind them. The floor is a tongue of pitted rock, cold and dry as a dead riverbed. Daylight spills in from the valley to the west and fails quickly. The tongue leads on east, toward a darker place where the roof closes in.

205504.description: Two great lumps of grey stone bulge from the walls on either side, folded and pitted like old sponge. The passage narrows between them and tips sharply, and a cold draught breathes up from below. Back to the west lies the mouth and its ranks of teeth. Ahead the floor falls away down into the throat.

205505.description: The floor is uneven here, the middle of the passage lower than the sides, which rise in smooth curves to meet the walls. The whole throat is graded, sloping steadily down into the dark. Behind you the stone climbs back toward the tonsils. Somewhere far below the rock seems to hum, as with a very slow breath.

205506.description: The tunnel loses its steepness and merely runs on, level, toward the east. The shapes of what might be petrified muscle ridge the walls in long ropes and bands. Up the slope behind you the throat climbs back toward the tonsils. A faint warmth wafts along the passage and touches your face.

205507.description: Four passages meet in a round chamber whose walls ripple with ribs of grey stone. A tunnel leaves north, another south, and a third runs east, while the throat you came down slopes away west. Ridges in the floor pulse faintly under your boots, slow as a heartbeat. The air is warm and carries a hint of char.

205508.description: This circular passage of smooth stone curves gently upward toward a place of great light and heat. Each step brings a fiercer glow from above, and the rock under your palm grows warm. To the south the way drops back to the round chamber of the junction. The walls glisten as though they sweat.

205509.description: Ancient fires burn here in a vast ribbed hollow, banked low and waiting for the rebirth of their master. Red light pulses from fissures in the rock, and the heat presses on your chest like a heavy hand. Curved ribs of stone arch overhead, and you half expect them to swell and fall. The only way out is the tunnel leading down.

205560.description: The dragon's throat continues east and west on a path that neither rises nor falls. The walls are smooth and faintly ribbed, cool except where a deep warmth seeps from one side. With it comes a feeling of pure evil, like a hand laid on the back of the neck. West the passage runs back to the junction, and east it opens onto a larger space.

205513.description: The tunnel ends on a ledge at the rim of an immense cavern, the dragon's stomach, where mists boil far below. A wooden bridge leaves the ledge eastward over the void, and the tunnel you came through runs back west. A steep, crumbling slope leads down off the ledge to the cavern floor. Stalagmites crowd the depths like a forest of spears, and the air stings the nose.

205514.description: You cannot imagine who would want to build a bridge in this fantastic cavern. Large stalagmites rise beneath the planks, and eerie lights seem to move in the mists below. The boards are damp and creak under your weight. The bridge continues east, and the ledge lies behind you to the west.

205515.description: You are in the middle of the wooden bridge, which sways a little on its long span. Great stalagmites rise around you, and the eerie lights dance on in the mists below. Planks stretch away into the haze both east and west. A faint sour hiss comes up from the depths.

205516.description: The wood here is old and acid-eaten, pitted and soft like the rest of the bridge. Deadly stalagmites jut up from below, and more of the green and yellow light moves slowly in the mists. A small plateau waits at the bridge's end to the east. The span behind you runs back west.

205527.description: The wooden bridge ends here on a broad plateau high above the cavern floor, which overlooks the whole forest of acid and stone below. In the wall to the east a tunnel has been shored up with a barricade of plaster and bones, and two very large skull-knobbed doors are set in it. A steep way leads down from the plateau's edge into the forest. The bridge runs back west.

205561.description: You are in a circular tunnel of stone, its walls irregular and pockmarked as if gnawed. The skull-knobbed doors stand to the west, closed behind you. The corridor goes on east toward a smoother, narrower bore. In the south wall a heavy door of dark wood is set, studded with bone.

205529.description: You enter a featureless tunnel, the beginning of the dragon's small intestine, its walls smooth and faintly glossy. Small piles of human bones and bits of armor have been left in its corners. The tunnel continues north. To the west a rougher passage leads back toward the plaster-and-bone corridor.

205530.description: The tunnel twists here in a smooth bend of blank stone. One arm leads east and the other south, and your footsteps come back doubled from both. A thin sourness hangs in the still air. The stone underfoot is faintly warm, as if something close by had only just stopped breathing.

205531.description: The smooth tunnel curves from the west toward the south, its walls tight and rounded like the inside of a pipe. The floor is faintly damp. Nothing marks the stone, and the dark ahead looks exactly like the dark behind.

205532.description: The blank walls of the tunnel run away north and south in an unbroken tube. Here and there the stone puckers in shallow folds, as if it had once moved. A slow draught drifts through, carrying the dull smell of old iron.

205533.description: The tunnel comes down from the north and dips sharply here, the floor tilting away into the gut of the dragon. The stone underfoot is polished smooth, and you must brace yourself against the walls to keep from sliding. The way leads down.

205534.description: The featureless tunnel leads up the slope behind you and onward north. Echoes bounce off the blank walls, and whether they come from near or far you cannot tell. The floor levels out here after the steep dip, and the walls close in again to the same blank, smooth curve. A dull, regular thud seems to come through the soles of your boots.

205535.description: Bits of broken equipment from long-dead adventurers have been swept together against the wall here: a dented helm, a snapped blade, rusted links of mail. The tunnel runs on north and south past the little heap. The stone is stained dark in streaks.

205536.description: The tunnel bends from the south toward the east. You imagine the remains of many a brave warrior who dared the dragon came this way, torn and unmourned. A scattering of old bone-dust lies in the angle of the wall. The air grows heavier as the passage turns.

205537.description: The blank walls of the tunnel lead west and south, narrowing slightly as they go. Fine grit crunches under your feet. The stone here is dull and without luster, as though long past any feeling. No light touches it, and the dark seems to press close against the skin.

205538.description: The smooth tunnel contracts to the south into a new, rougher bore. North and east, passages wind away through the same blank stone, each as featureless as the last. A dry scrape of dust stirs in the throat of the narrowing.

205541.description: Unlike the small intestine, the walls here have a nook-and-cranny quality, rough and crowded with little hollows. Dust fills many of the spaces and puffs up with each step. The smooth passage lies back to the north, and this tunnel runs on east.

205542.description: The smell of dust is thick in this section of the tunnel, which runs to the west and to the north. Ridges of rough rock crowd the walls, and a gritty haze hangs in the air. Your breathing sounds loud in the narrow space.

205543.description: The rough walls of the tunnel scrape your armor and cut your exposed skin as you travel north or south. Sharp ledges of stone stand out like the edges of broken tiles. The dust here lies in drifts along the floor.

205544.description: The floor of the tunnel drops away toward the east, but you find many handholds among the nooks and crannies of the wall. Grit trickles from the ceiling each time you shift your weight. South, the passage runs back toward a dustier stretch.

205545.description: The roughly hewn tunnel constricts to the south, the walls drawing in until they almost touch. Dust is packed deep in the cracks. West, the passage opens a little and winds back the way you came. Splinters of rock lie loose across the floor, and every step seems to dislodge more of them.

205546.description: You are in a narrow tunnel, barely able to walk upright without knocking your head on the stone. A breeze from the east swirls the dust and cools your face, and you begin to believe that safety is not far off. Behind you to the north the rough passage of the large intestine winds away into the dark. The walls here are worn almost smooth by some long passage of wind.

rooms.205547: The dragon's stone tail tapers out here into open air, a long grey spur lying half buried in leaf mold and ferns. Oaks have grown tall around it, and daylight slants green through their branches. Moss has crept up the scaled flank of the stone, and the last of the cave-damp fades from your clothes. The path winds west through the trees, around the great body toward the dragon's head.

205528.description: You are in an oddly shaped chamber, what might once have been some foul organ of Ancalador. A yellowish light fills the room from nowhere, as if by the dragon's will alone. The feeling of malignant evil is great here, made worse by the large sign overhead. A door leads north back to the corridor, an opening is worked into the wall to the east, and a stair of grey stone spirals down.

205550.description: Shaking shrubs and quivering palms surround a few skeletal trees in this gruesome garden. The shriveled plants stand in niches within the deformed chamber walls, and all seem to have died and come back from the afterlife somehow. Pale fungus glows on the soil between them. Openings in the petrified organ wall lead west and down.

205555.description: This chamber of hard stone is empty save for a sturdy iron ring set into the floor. A large, heavy chain is fastened to the ring, with a collar at its free end. The floor around it is scored by claws and scuffed bare. A stairway climbs up toward the garden, and a low archway leads south.

205556.description: This circular chamber is dominated by a large stone slab in the center, bearing the stains of countless horrible experiments. Trays of knives and saws stand fixed on stone shelves around the curved wall. The cruel work that goes on here is generally watched from the amphitheater above by guild apprentices and patrons. The kennel lies to the north.

205552.description: Tiers of curved stone benches rise in a half ring around an open well, from which one may look down upon the operating room below. Everything is bone-grey and worn smooth by the seats of patient watchers. Candles gutter in sconces shaped like fingers. A door to the east leads to private chambers, and a broad archway to the west opens onto the temple.

205551.description: This small room seems to have been carved by hand from the pancreas of Ancalador. It has some amenities, like a soft bed and a small alchemist's workbench strewn with stained glassware. If the dragon is ever freed from his stone prison, he will surely be quite unhappy about this. The only way out is the door to the west.

205553.description: A hall of black stone, hung with funeral drapes, rises about a dais where the guild offers its prayers to death. Rows of tall candles burn with a flame that gives no warmth. Carved skulls grin from every pillar, and the air tastes of ash. The amphitheater lies east, and a stairway of pale steps descends into the guildhall below.

205557.description: The guildhall is a long, low chamber lit by black candles, its walls hung with the banners of the Bloodstone. Heavy tables and high-backed chairs stand about a great hearth that gives off only cold. A stair climbs up to the temple above. North lies the way into the cold storage, and a door of black iron stands in the west wall.

205554.description: The stink of this storage chamber makes you balk at once. Through your nausea you make out cadavers kept cool in niches in the stone walls, row upon row of them. Barrels of dust and decanters of blood fill the floor. A stair rises up toward the pancreas, and a passage runs south to the guildhall.

205558.description: You stand before the horrific Altar of Annihilation, where the magic of extinguishment and dissolution is explored. Countless ceremonies of extinction have left a gloom that hangs over the stone. The altar looks like a huge rib cage centered on a demon's skull. Before it, a black iron grating covers a dark pit where the ebb of life is glorified in sacrifice. The guildhall lies east, and the grating gives way down.

205559.description: The very evil of this place seeks to extinguish your light, as if the gloom had a nefarious soul of its own. The walls of the pit are slick and black, and there is no sound but your own breath. You know true fear as something moves in the darkness, toward you. The only way out is up, back to the altar.

205523.description: The stalagmites here are large and rainbow-hued, like giants in jesters' garb, and they stand thick on the cavern floor. Puddles of weak stomach acid are pooled in every hollow, hissing faintly. Mist drifts between the pillars. The cavern stretches on north, south and west.

205520.description: Sharp stalagmites reach upward, grown from the mineral ichors that drip off stalactites far above. Pools of acid fill every crevice of the craggy cavern floor, and the stone around them is bitten and pocked. The cavern floor falls away south and west into the mist.

205519.description: The stalagmites here are tall and banded in rainbow colors, like jesters stiff in their finery. Shallow puddles of stomach acid stand between them, shivering as drops fall from the dark above. The cavern opens to the east, south and west. A sharp tang of vinegar hangs in the mist.

205522.description: You are in the center of the dragon's stomach cavern. A wooden bridge passes far overhead, a thin line against the dark roof. Sharp stalagmites stand ready here to meet any that might drop from it. Acid pools between them, and paths of the cavern lead off in every direction.

205525.description: Sharp, narrow stalagmites crowd this part of the cavern, grown by the slow drip of minerals from stalactites far overhead. The floor is craggy and wet, with acid gathered in every crack. You pick your way north, east and west among the spikes. The hiss of the pools never quite stops.

205526.description: The stalagmites here are large and rainbow-hued, like giants in jesters' garb, and the largest of them leans over a wide puddle. Weak stomach acid has eaten channels through the floor. The cavern stretches to the north and west along the curve of the wall, where the stone runs wet and green.

205524.description: Mists swirl around strange crystal egg shells here, their domed halves glittering and long since emptied. Stalagmites crowd close beside them, and slick stone slopes underfoot. The cavern continues north and east. A sweet, sickly smell clings to the mist.

205521.description: You stand before an amazing sight. Wrapped within the mists on the cavern floor is a forest of oddly shaped stalagmites, surrounded everywhere by puddles of what must be the remnants of the dragon's stomach acid. The cavern spreads north, east and south, and a rough slope leads up to the ledge above.

205518.description: Needle-sharp stalagmites rise in thickets from the stone, nourished by mineral ichors that drip from the dark. Pools of acid collect in every crevice, and the rock steams where they meet. The cavern wall presses close here, running with green slime. The way on leads east and south.

205511.description: This stone passage is lit by a great light and fierce heat from its far end, which lies above. The floor tilts upward in a long curve, and the walls are warm as a baker's oven. The way north leads back to the junction of tunnels, and the glare ahead pulses slow and red.

205512.description: The nuclear fires that gave the dragon its frightful breath burn here, and though they have smoldered for so very long, they scorch you and make you rue wearing metal armor. Cracks of white heat run through the vaulted stone. The tunnel descends from this furnace, the only way out.

205527.keywords: doors skull-knobbed skull doors barricade plaster bones
205527.description: Two huge doors of grey wood, each knobbed with a grinning skull, are set in a wall of plaster packed with bones. The workmanship is crude but strong, and it is plainly meant to keep something in or out.

205528.description: A large sign hangs overhead, lettered in dull black: Memento Mori. In the common tongue it means: Remember to Die.

205555.description: The heavy chain is bolted to an iron ring in the floor, its collar worn from long use. Small print on the collar reads: Quietus.

205554.description: On the wall, in some dark ink, is scrawled: That dreamless sleep.

205558.description: The altar is a great rib cage of pale bone, set round a demon's skull. Before it, a black iron grating covers the pit below, its bars worn bright where hands have gripped it.
